placement.note: DRAW AT 1:1. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so the scale is 1 — never resample scenery. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the white triquetra on the rock changes: a few pixels along that edge shift very slightly in brightness and shift straight back. The white triquetra on the rock is fully visible and exactly as easy to read in every single frame, including the last -- it never fades, never dims, never vanishes and is never swallowed by glare. Its inside stays exactly the white it is in the first frame and never washes out into a plain bright blur. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
